name: Fractal Simplex Noise
definition: Generates fractal noise by summing octaves of simplex noise until the feature size (scale) is smaller than one pixel, determined by the inverse of the derivative `du`.
summary: Fractal Simplex Noise generates multi-scale procedural volume data by summing octaves of Simplex Noise, offering superior gradient continuity and reduced directional artifacts compared to Perlin noise.
